newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU buys in 10,321 tonnes of beef.
newsitem.headline: EU buys in 10,321 tonnes of beef.

text.p: The European Union's beef management committee accepted a total of 10,321 tonnes of beef into intervention on Friday, a Commission spokesman said.
"The Commission accepted a higher level of bids than expected in view of the low tenders offered," the official added.
The committee accepted 1,645 tonnes of category A and 8,676 of category C bids making a total of 10,321 tonnes at a maximum price of 273 ecus per 100 kg for both.
Tenders for category A beef above 259.14 ecus per 100 kg were reduced in quantity by 25 percent. Tenders for category C beef above 253.01 ecus per 100 kg were also reduced in quantity by 25 percent.
Commenting on the low level of tenders a Commission official said it reinforced the Commission's view that the EU beef market is returning to normal.
